title: MemoryGarden CC0-only 3D plant and garden shortlist

constraints.licenses: CC0-1.0 only; no CC BY; Hugging Face objaverse-clean-glb was not used
constraints.style: Soft, stylized, painterly, low-to-mid poly, dusk and pastel palettes; not photoreal
constraints.runtime: three.js GLTFLoader, lazy-loaded GLBs from public/, main JS bundle budget 400 KB
constraints.three_js_note: Load MeshoptDecoder on GLTFLoader (three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js). These optimized files will not load without it.

alternates_measured.name: Flower Empodium
alternates_measured.style_fit: Photoreal small yellow wildflower. Unoptimized 1k GLB 894,208 bytes; optimized 78,216 bytes, 3,026 tris. Could be restyled but clashes as-is.

alternates_measured.name: Shrub Sorrel 01
alternates_measured.style_fit: Photoreal pink sorrel sprigs. Unoptimized 1k GLB 1,178,832 bytes; optimized 76,072 bytes, 3,284 tris. Pretty, but photoreal and sparse in frame.

not_found_in_these_packs: No lantern and no bench in Kenney Nature Kit or Quaternius Ultimate Nature. Kenney also has campfires, signs, statues, tents and canoes if a different prop is wanted later.
No stylized fern in Kenney or Quaternius Ultimate Nature; Poly Haven fern_02 is the only fern, and it is photoreal.
